name: D · 月衡观星
summary: 乌发长簪 · 直襟窄袖 · 沉静理性
detail: A composed thoughtful divination Taoist, mature slightly LONG rounded face with blunt chin, low straight brows, narrow relaxed half-lidded simple eyes and a barely visible wry smile; subtly different eyes from A's sly look, no heavy lashes. INK BLACK straight collarbone-length hair with crisp horizontal fringe and a long horizontal JADE PIN through a neat low folded back section; a small flat moon-jade dao cap, no high crest/horns, braid or ponytail. MOON WHITE/deep blue-gray/jade and a trace of old gold. Clean vertical Chinese high diagonal-collar fitted jacket over fuller adult bust, narrow jade sash and two long STRAIGHT open outer robe lapels forming broad rectangular ivory planes, one fitted long sleeve and one quiet draped sleeve at forearm; charcoal trousers and plain slate-blue boots, both feet read. ONLY one large sparse blue cloud/star-compass abstract motif on lower hem, no many little constellations. Silhouette vertical rectangles and one round disc, restrained cloth motion. POSE calm upright contrapposto, one arm bent before waist holding a SMALL horizontal bronze Taoist LUOPAN compass disc with a central yin-yang and eight simple broad radial sectors (graphic diagram, no tiny text), the other hand extending a plain jade measuring pointer toward left at chest height. Disc sits stably on supporting palm, pointer held between natural fingers, no floating instruments or unnecessary staff. Not holding a fan or book. Strong quiet scholarly identity, no big cape wings.
